lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's thirty-five? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 35? Nope!

lines.text: Line up four X tiles and four O tiles.
lines.caption: Line up 4 X tiles and 4 O tiles.

lines.text: Left to right, X must never fall behind O. How many strings?
lines.caption: Left to right, X must never fall behind O. How many strings?

lines.text: Turn each string into a walk. X steps right, O steps down.
lines.caption: Turn each string into a walk. X steps right, O steps down.

lines.text: X never falls behind, so the walk never crosses this wall.
lines.caption: X never falls behind, so the walk never crosses this wall.

lines.text: Each spot is the number on its left, plus the number above.
lines.caption: Each spot is the number on its left, plus the number above.

lines.text: On the wall, the left is blocked, so copy the one above!
lines.caption: On the wall, the left is blocked, so copy the 1 above!

lines.text: Keep adding to the corner. That's fourteen strings!
lines.caption: Keep adding to the corner. That's 14 strings!

lines.text: Thirty-five was the trap. That's just half of seventy.
lines.caption: 35 was the trap. That's just half of 70.

lines.text: Did you get fourteen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 14? Tell me below!
